# Six Grid and Table records leave the examples catalog

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

The Retire table of the Grid & Table slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)), a leaf of #21175 (the Grid & Table group, under #21140). The slate opened and used all 21 entries of the group.

## The Problem

Six cards of the group show a visitor nothing the card beside them does not show better, and each one costs the group its credibility:

| Record | Folder | Why it leaves |
|---|---|---|
| `table-covid` | `examples/table/covid` | The table twin of `grid-covid`: same data, same frame. |
| `table-cell-editing` | `examples/table/cellEditing` | The twin of `grid-cell-editing`, and its Country column renders empty. |
| `table-nested-record-fields` | `examples/table/nestedRecordFields` | The twin of `grid-nested-record-fields`. |
| `table-performance` | `examples/tablePerformance` | A bench from 2019: three tables of "Column3 - 0" cells that flash red. |
| `table-store` | `examples/tableStore` | Six names and three buttons; every other card shows sorting and store updates. |
| `json-grid-container` | `examples/serverside/gridContainer` | An empty box and a button, then the six names. The JSON it is about never shows. |

The slate's seventh retiring entry, `examples/grid/lockedColumns`, is not part of this ticket: its record `grid-locked-columns` stays and is pointed at a new example by #21167.

## The Architectural Reality

- The records are in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`; all six carry `"family": "grid-table"` and a cover since PR #21161.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins the family: the case "the catalog holds the 21 Grid and Table identities and the overview shows the covered ones", the covered ids and several totals. `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` reads the same catalog.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` is generated from the catalog: `node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs -f seo-json -o apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, checked by `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs`.
- PR #21162 (#21141) rewrites the same spec and turns the groups into data; this change lands after it.
- PR #21182 (#21169) gives a standalone example an opt-out from `sitemap-core.xml`, `seo.json` and `llms.txt`: `"seo": false` in its `neo-config.json`. At its head `4a9eeff907` all six pages are indexed, the 2019 bench as "Table Performance — Web Worker Data Grid Demo".
- The folders are loaded by specs and stay: for example `examples/table/cellEditing` and `examples/table/covid` each have a spec file of their own.
- Design authority: the Retire table of [#21142, part 1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418): "The record leaves the catalog. The folder stays wherever specs load it."

## The Fix

1. Remove the six records from `examples.json`.
2. Bring the unit spec to the new family: 15 identities, the covered ids, the totals. The case's title says 15.
3. **What leaves the catalog leaves the sitemap.** Once PR #21182 is on `dev`, each of the six folders gets `"seo": false` in its `neo-config.json`. If it is not merged when this lands, the pull request says so and the opt-out follows with whichever lands second.
4. Regenerate `seo.json`.
5. Nothing under `examples/` is deleted or moved.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The six ids are gone from the catalog; `grid-locked-columns` and the other 14 records of the family are byte-identical.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples` and `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo` pass, and `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `git diff --stat` shows no path under `examples/` other than the six `neo-config.json` files.
- [ ] None of the six standalone routes is in the regenerated `seo.json`, and `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passes (or the pull request names #21182 as not yet merged).
- [ ] The PR shows `/examples/grid` at 1440 × 900 before and after, from a real browser.
- [ ] The PR names any other place that counts the family's records (the release notes of #21032 count examples) and says whether it changes.

## Out of Scope

Deleting an example's folder or spec; the six cover files on Pages, which stay until a sweep there; the renewed and the new examples (their own leaves under #21175); a home for `examples/serverside/gridContainer` in another group, which the slate's whole table decides.

## Avoided Traps

- **Waiting for the six new examples.** A twin never counted as a demonstration (#20500's Avoided Traps), so the group loses nothing a visitor could use.
- **Removing `grid-locked-columns` here.** Two leaves would then edit one record.
- **Deleting the folders.** Specs load them.
